name: agent-messenger-whatsapp
description: Read WhatsApp messages, find and organize contacts, send replies and images, and manage messaging campaigns with Agent Messenger.

interface.longDescription:
WhatsApp by Agent Messenger connects your WhatsApp conversations to ChatGPT so you can read messages, find contacts, prepare replies, and send the messages you approve. Bring your WhatsApp inbox into your AI workflow for customer support, sales follow-ups, client communication, and everyday conversations. Ask in plain language and choose what your assistant can read, manage, or send.

READ WHATSAPP CHATS AND MESSAGE HISTORY
Browse recently active chats and open a conversation to read its messages. Ask ChatGPT to summarize a discussion, identify questions, extract action items, or explain what a customer needs. Review message history before drafting your next reply, and page back through earlier messages when needed. Recent-chat previews come from the history Agent Messenger has recorded; open a chat for its available message history. Media messages can include links to images, videos, voice notes, and documents, with supported images available for the assistant to inspect.

SEND WHATSAPP REPLIES AND IMAGES
Draft a WhatsApp reply, refine the wording, and send your chosen text from your own connected number. Send an image with an optional caption. Resolve the recipient by name or phone number before sending, and check the account's live connection status when needed. For messages to multiple recipients, preview the exact audience and text before approving delivery. Sent WhatsApp messages cannot be recalled through this app.

FIND AND ORGANIZE WHATSAPP CONTACTS
Search stored contacts by name, nickname, or phone number, or filter them by tag. Add contacts and organize them into groups such as customers, suppliers, or follow-ups using contact tags. Create, rename, and delete tags, and add or remove a tag from a contact. Rename contacts created in Agent Messenger or remove them when appropriate. Contact search covers contacts already synced or added to the app; contacts never synced will not appear, and names synced from WhatsApp must be changed on the phone.

PLAN AND MANAGE MESSAGING CAMPAIGNS
Create a draft WhatsApp campaign for selected contacts or a tagged audience. Review the message and recipients, then start delivery or schedule it for a future time after approval. Messages are sent one at a time with a delay between recipients. Check campaign details, progress, recipient send status, and skipped recipients. Pause, resume, or cancel campaigns as your plans change. Starting or scheduling a campaign authorizes delivery to its audience; it can continue sending after the conversation with your assistant ends. Use campaigns for updates and follow-ups with people who expect to hear from you.

HELP WITH DAILY COMMUNICATION
Use your WhatsApp assistant to catch up on customer conversations, prepare answers to product questions, coordinate appointments, or organize client follow-ups. Turn the messages you retrieve into summaries and a practical list of next steps. You can review a draft before asking for a send, or ask only for information when no reply is needed. The app works with the WhatsApp accounts you connect and the permissions you grant.

TRY THESE PROMPTS
"Show my recent WhatsApp chats and summarize the latest conversation."
"Find my customer by name and show our five latest messages."
"Draft a reply confirming tomorrow's appointment."
"Preview this message for the contacts I selected without sending it."
"Show my campaign's progress and which recipients were skipped."

WhatsApp by Agent Messenger is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to WhatsApp or Meta. The WhatsApp name and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
defaultPrompt: Show my recent WhatsApp chats and summarize the latest conversation.
Find a WhatsApp contact by name and draft a reply for me to approve.
Show my WhatsApp campaigns and their progress.

positive.description: Identify the connected WhatsApp account and check its live status.
positive.prompt: Show my connected WhatsApp account and check whether it is live now.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected account and reports its provider-reported connection status without changing it.

positive.description: Find a seeded demo contact and inspect recent messages.
positive.prompt: Find Demo Customer in my WhatsApp contacts and show the five most recent messages in that chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching demo contact and up to five messages in newest-first order, without inventing missing content.

positive.description: Organize a seeded demo contact under a tag.
positive.prompt: Find Demo Customer in my WhatsApp contacts and add the Follow-up tag.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the demo contact and adds the Follow-up tag, creating the tag if needed.

positive.description: Preview a message for two seeded demo contacts without delivery.
positive.prompt: Prepare a WhatsApp message saying 'Review test: tomorrow at 10' for Demo Customer and Demo Colleague. Show me the preview and do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows resolved and skipped recipients and a short-lived preview token; no message is delivered.

positive.description: Send a single message to a consenting demo recipient controlled for review.
positive.prompt: Send 'Review test: hello' to Demo Recipient on WhatsApp now.
positive.expected_behavior: Delivers the exact text to the selected demo chat once and reports the send result.

negative.description: Telegram chats are outside this WhatsApp-only MCP. Explain the limitation without invoking a tool or claiming Telegram access.
LinkedIn messages are outside this WhatsApp-only MCP. Explain the limitation without invoking a tool or claiming delivery.
negative.prompt: Reply to my latest LinkedIn message.

negative.description: This MCP cannot delete delivered WhatsApp messages. Explain that limitation without calling a contact deletion tool or claiming a message was removed.
negative.prompt: Delete the last WhatsApp message I sent for everyone.

review.commerce_description: The tools do not sell products or process payments; any Agent Messenger subscription is managed on the website.
